bootstrap.cluster_rows: all seven organ rows share one participant multiplicity
bootstrap.sampling: within each outer-fold stratum, sample the original number of participants with replacement

age_estimand.aggregation: pool all seven organ rows and all five outer folds
age_estimand.predictions: raw chronological-age predictions; no bootstrap recalibration

risk_estimand.models: age+sex base and age+sex+corrected_age_gap full Cox models fitted once on the frozen fold-calibration role
risk_estimand.bootstrap_rule: reuse sealed/frozen nuisance coefficients and held-out risk scores; never refit inside a bootstrap replicate
risk_estimand.cell_metric: Harrell C using exact integer participant multiplicities
risk_estimand.delta_c: C_full minus C_base within outer-fold and organ
risk_estimand.organ_aggregation: unweighted mean over five outer folds
risk_estimand.macro_aggregation: unweighted mean over the seven organ estimates
risk_estimand.paired_difference: EHR-AGE delta C minus baseline delta C on the identical replicate
risk_estimand.base_model_note: the age+sex base score and its bootstrap C are common to all methods within a fold-organ cell
